notes: Built by running homeassistant/components/zamg/weather.py's own ZamgWeather (Home Assistant 2026.10.4) over coordinator data in the shape zamg 0.4.1 returns for GeoSphere Austria's 10-minute station data; core tests only setup and the config flow. Values are realistic for Graz/Flughafen (station 11240, 340 m) on a foggy November morning. Native units are °C, hPa, m/s and mm. Current only, no forecasts and no supported_features attribute, and no condition at all: the entity never sets one, so its state is always 'unknown'. temperature is TLAM (10-minute mean), else TL; humidity RFAM; wind_speed FFAM (mean), else FFX (the gust); wind_bearing DD, else DDX; all floats. pressure is P, the pressure at the station's height (981.6 hPa here), not the sea-level PRED (1024.1) that the integration's sensors show separately, so it reads some 40 hPa below a sea-level figure. Never visibility, dew point (TP is only a sensor), apparent temperature, gusts, cloud cover or UV.
